creator: Dan McCreary

Metadata
Search
Boolean Logic
description: A p5.js faceted search lab over a 300-record sample of the MicroSim catalog. Learners toggle Subject, Framework and Bloom level chips with live counts, switch within-facet logic between OR and AND, watch the records-remaining bar and title list, and predict the count before each change. Records with no value appear under (missing).
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: Using facets and within-facet OR/AND logic to narrow a catalog
learningObjectives: The learner will use facet selections to narrow a sample of the MicroSim catalog to a short list, and will predict how switching a facet between OR and AND logic changes the count before checking the result.
prerequisites: Faceted search and the search index (Chapter 15)

accessibility.notes: The canvas is focusable: Tab and Shift+Tab move between chips, Space toggles; selected chips differ by fill, border and text color; counts are shown as numbers

controls.label: Facet value chips
controls.purpose: Toggle a value in the Subject, Framework or Bloom level facet

controls.label: Within a facet: OR / AND
controls.purpose: Choose OR or AND logic inside each facet (facets always combine with AND)

controls.label: Predict first
controls.purpose: Hide counts until the learner types an expected count and makes one change

controls.label: Predicted count
controls.purpose: The learner's expected number of records

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Hands-on practice with real catalog data and a predict-then-check gate
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Faceted filter with live counts and prediction
keyQuestions: What happens to the count when two values in one facet switch from OR to AND?
Why does AND within Framework always give zero?
How many records does a Bloom level filter hide because the field is missing?
commonMisconceptions: Selecting more values always narrows the result
A facet count is the size of the whole result
Missing metadata is harmless for search
assessmentOpportunities: Reaching a short list with two or more facets
Direction of predicted change for OR to AND
Explaining zero results for AND within a single-valued facet

dataSources: search-microsims repository, docs/search/microsims-data.json (3,764 records on 2026-09-30); 300-record sample with seed 2026 in sample.json
